# Empty-state illustrations

Current artwork: [Isocons](https://www.isocons.app/), fetched 6 November 2026 from its public catalog. Licensed under [Creative Commons Attribution 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Shared `EmptyIllustration` includes visible linked attribution. A copy of the attribution notice ships with the assets.

| Local file | Catalog item | Style |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `empty.svg` | Create new folder | Edge / Sharp / Left |
| `requests.svg` | Cards | Edge / Sharp / Left |
| `search.svg` | Manage Search | Edge / Sharp / Left |
| `notifications.svg` | Browse activity | Edge / Sharp / Left |

Changes: SVG markup serialized from public catalog, black strokes changed to neutral gray. Rendered locally as decorative images; dark mode inverts them. No people, remote image calls or animation dependencies. Earlier unDraw assets have been replaced.

Prestige UI was investigated at the user's request; its isometric registry requires a Pro license. No gated Prestige UI code was copied. The user chose Isocons instead.
